title: LookNight
description: How the game shows the compute night (B7, B2579/B2580, D637 R12-R14): the picture darkens into the dream scene when the night begins and the morning fades in once the AI service is done. Presentation only; all values are placeholders until Marcel's word.

fade_out_s.description: Real seconds the picture takes to darken into the dream scene.

fade_in_s.description: Real seconds the morning takes to fade in.

min_scene_s.description: The dream scene stays at least this long (real seconds), also when the service has nothing to do - short, but without a jolt.

darkness.description: How dark the dream scene is at most (0 = the world as it is, 1 = black). Below 1 the sleeping world stays faintly visible.

poll_s.description: Real seconds between two questions to the service how far the night is (GET /phase).

lost_after_polls.description: A1586 (B7 R16): after this many questions in a row that the service did not answer (gone, or not ready), the night is taken as unknown and the scene ends after its minimum time instead of waiting for the morning. Omitted = the scene waits for an answer (as before).

sleep_actions.description: Actions during which an inhabitant counts as asleep and shows 'Zzz' in the dream scene (vocabulary ids).

zzz_above_head_m.description: How far above the head anchor the 'Zzz' floats (metres).

zzz_sway_s.description: Real seconds of one slow rise-and-fade of the 'Zzz' (0 = still; 'reduce motion' keeps it still).

zzz_rise_px.description: How far the 'Zzz' rises during one sway (pixels at the reference height, scaled with the UI).

NightDreams.description: Dream images of the night scene (B2579, D637 R11/R13): things the night's jobs are about appear softly, spread over the screen, and fade again. Only real jobs of this night are shown; an empty queue shows none. The limits keep it calm: with min_gap_s at least 0.7 s there are never more than three changes of brightness per second (protection for light-sensitive players), whatever the other values say.

fade_in_s.description: Real seconds an image takes to appear.

fade_out_s.description: Real seconds it takes to fade.

max_at_once.description: Most images on screen at once; more wait their turn.

min_gap_s.description: Least real seconds between two images appearing.

size_px.description: Size of an image (pixels at the reference height, scaled with the UI).

brightness.description: Greatest opacity of an image (soft, never glaring).

reduce_motion_factor.description: With 'reduce motion' the fades take this many times as long.

appearances.description: What a job kind shows: 'symbol' = the shape of the object type it is about, as soon as the job is seen; 'image' = that symbol and, once the job is done, the picture it made; 'none' = nothing. Kinds not listed show nothing.
